ns2:section.sectionText: This section will open to all students in the Gies College of Business on Monday, May 3, 2021 at approximately 10:00 a.m. This section will open to French Commercial, Industrial & Enterprise Systems Engineering, General Engineering and Systems Engineering & Design students on Monday, May 10, 2021 at approximately 10:00 a.m. This section will open to all of campus to allow Business Minor and prospective Business Minor students the option to register for this elective not offered as an online option on Monday, May 17, 2021 at approximately 10:00 a.m. There are currently 10 seats reserved for Gies College of Business international exchange students only (any exchange students outside of GCOB who try to register will be removed); any unused seats will be released to students meeting the restrictions on Friday, August 27, 2021 at approximately 10:00 a.m. This is an elective course for undergraduate students pursuing the business minor.
